order: CLOVER then RF, one sequential pass; no cache flush or real-time isolation; inter-frame Python/archive processing excluded
instrumentation: Each interval includes clock-call overhead; CLOVER complete interval includes an extra internal boundary clock. RF summed intervals include two intervals. No subtraction. Interrupt/preemption included.
scope: Replayable observation/provider-output boundary only. Complete producer-to-consumer pipeline NOT measured: records lack raw integrity envelopes, probe transactions and Triplex producer transitions. Shared-upstream figure excludes those stages; do not call it full shared cost.
fairness_limit: Pre-fusion region includes CLOVER provenance preparation; it is not a clean isolated common-provider cost. RF arithmetic sum is not an executed complete pipeline. Full common upstream and complete producer-to-decision pipelines are unmeasured.
